name: Direction-sensitive dark matter search results in a surface laboratory
notes: Surface laboratory (not Kamioka): the facility is not recorded on this result.

summary.plain: NEWAGE built a three-dimensional gas tracking detector and ran a first dark matter search in a surface laboratory, drawing a sky map of recoil directions. It set the first spin-dependent WIMP-proton limit obtained with a direction-sensitive method.
summary.technical: 150 Torr CF4 micro-TPC; surface-laboratory (not underground) run; first direction-sensitive limit on the spin-dependent WIMP-proton cross section. The abstract does not state a numerical limit.

title: Direction-sensitive dark matter search results in a surface laboratory
why_it_matters: The abstract calls it the first limit set by a direction-sensitive method; it showed a WIMP search with a gaseous tracking device can set limits.
